raw_text: Bike lane alignment looks reasonable. Parking concerns from local shops should be heard.
Cycling counts after the alignment look strong (2,980 projected). Will use this route daily.
Parking spaces lost (84). Want mitigation. Otherwise neutral on the alignment itself.
Tree canopy on Rachel feels minimal. Glad to see the 22.4% GIS reading guiding the plan.
Worried about displacement in Parc-Extension. Need to know how city plans protect renters.
Intercept N=312 total. Balanced sentiment overall. Most cited issue: parking mitigation. Most cited support: cycling-trip projections (2,980 after) and tree-canopy progress (22.4 percent).
